note: v0.1.0 is released. v0.2 is now the registry workflow: sync, remove and list --installed, gh skill interop with adopt, custom agent layouts, and a registry validation Action. Parked: global installs, more built-in agents, skill diff, checksum manifest.

criticalPath.title: Create or prepare hasankhatib/ai as the separate registry repository

risks: The real hasankhatib/ai registry still needs to exist with skills/index.json before skill list/install can work end to end.
Docs must continue to avoid implying that Hikma AI itself is a canonical skill registry; it is the CLI that works with user-configured registries.
HasanKhatib/ai is currently a README-only private repo; add skills and make it public before documenting it as the example registry.
Push to a registry you cannot write to fails until the fork flow lands; document it for v0.1.0.
